archetypes.name: Two-Way Big
archetypes.desc: Interior forward who rebounds both ends and scores inside — the do-it-all frontcourt anchor.

archetypes.name: Rim Protector
archetypes.desc: Shot-blocking, offensive-rebounding big who lives at the rim; the defensive anchor.

archetypes.name: Rim-Runner
archetypes.desc: Rolls, crashes the offensive glass and draws fouls — vertical spacing, little range.

archetypes.name: Lead Creator
archetypes.desc: Ball-dominant lead guard who runs the offense — high usage AND high assists.

archetypes.name: Point-of-Attack Guard
archetypes.desc: Small, disruptive on-ball defender who steals, pushes and sets up teammates.

archetypes.name: Scoring Guard
archetypes.desc: Undersized combo guard who shoots and creates his own — a bucket-getter.

archetypes.name: Shot Creator
archetypes.desc: High-usage wing/forward who manufactures shots off the dribble — the primary scorer.

archetypes.name: 3&D Wing
archetypes.desc: Low-usage spot-up shooter who spaces the floor and guards — the connective 3&D role.

archetypes.name: Slashing Wing
archetypes.desc: Attacks the rim and draws fouls, pressures the ball — a two-way slasher.

archetypes.name: Glue Forward
archetypes.desc: Low-usage forward who rebounds and connects without needing the ball — the glue guy.
